newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures drift up late, end higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures drift up late, end higher.

text.p: U.S. debt futures drifted up in afternoon trade and ended near session highs.
June Treasury bond futures crawled above Friday's session high and closed above there, posting an outside day with a higher close on daily bar charts.
Traders said short-covering developed after a Fed coupon pass near midday, and cited some nervousness before key U.S. data on Tuesday.
"We had a nice little bit of a bid here in the last 45 minutes," a Eurodollar trader said. "Going into ECI and durable goods we're seeing a little short-covering," he said.
He said the coupon pass "took some time to filter in."
Another trader said players had not been expecting a coupon pass until May, catching some by surprise.
"We had some weak shorts covering up after the coupon pass, but mostly I think people are just nervous before ECI," he said.

The first quarter employment cost index, to be released at 0730 CDT/1230 GMT Tuesday, was forecast to rise 0.9 percent compared with an 0.8-percent gain in the previous report. March durable goods will also be released. Overall orders are forecast unchanged, with ex-defense down 0.1 percent.
Traders said short-term technicals perked up a bit after Monday's higher close, but noted that the hefty data line-up this week would direct price action.
First-quarter growth, April National Association of Purchasing Management and payrolls data were also on tap.
A Eurodollar trader put September near-term support at 93.59 and 93.65, with resistance at 93.71, 93.72 and 93.77.
Resistance in June T-bonds was pegged at 107-16/32 and 107-27/32, with support at 106-30/32 and 106-24/32.
"Most of the day it was slow, but in the afternoon we saw a steady squeeze up and volume did increase," a trader said.

At the close, June T-bonds were up 9/32 to 107-13/32, 10-year notes rose 05/32 to 105-20/32, September T-bills were up 0.015 at 94.260, September Eurodollars were up 0.025 at 93.695 and December Eurodollars were 0.020 higher at 93.395.
